A fence inside a footnote definition's continuation must keep the unindented line that follows. Ours emits `code 1..1 ""` -- the fence opens and closes on its own line -- so the line parses as live text, its `%%` becomes a comment, and the label inside becomes a reference Obsidian does not have. Five implementation attempts are recorded against this shape and all five regressed the corpus; the 2x2 of (global vs per-container fence signal) x (blank arm inverted vs stock) measured -42, -113, -42 inert, -74 and -171. Kept because the rule is oracle-verified and the next attempt must not re-derive it.
